actions.amazon_s3_copy_file.description: Copies a file to another key in the connected bucket.
actions.amazon_s3_copy_file.props.destin: The full key to copy to, including the file name, e.g. "archive/q1.csv".
actions.amazon_s3_copy_file.props.source: The full key of the file to copy, as returned by List Files.
A version id from List File Versions to copy an older version. Leave empty for the current version.
actions.amazon_s3_delete_file_tags.descr: Removes all tags from a file.
actions.amazon_s3_delete_file_tags.props: The full key (path) of the file, as returned by List Files.
A version id from List File Versions. Leave empty for the current version.
actions.amazon_s3_delete_files.descripti: Deletes up to 1000 files from the connected bucket in one call.
actions.amazon_s3_delete_files.props.key: The full keys of the files to delete (1–1000), as returned by List Files.
actions.amazon_s3_get_file_metadata.desc: Gets a file's size, content type, last modified date and custom metadata without downloading it.
actions.amazon_s3_get_file_metadata.prop: The full key (path) of the file, e.g. "reports/2024/q1.csv", as returned by List Files.
A version id from List File Versions. Leave empty for the current version.
actions.amazon_s3_get_file_tags.descript: Gets the tags on a file.
actions.amazon_s3_get_file_tags.props.ke: The full key (path) of the file, as returned by List Files.
actions.amazon_s3_get_file_tags.props.ve: A version id from List File Versions. Leave empty for the current version.
actions.amazon_s3_list_file_versions.des: Lists the versions and delete markers of files in the connected bucket.
actions.amazon_s3_list_file_versions.pro: The nextKeyMarker from a previous call, to get the next page.
Maximum number of versions and delete markers to return in this page (1–1000). Defaults to 100.
Only list versions of keys that start with this prefix, e.g. a full file key or "reports/". Leave empty for the whole bucket.
The nextVersionIdMarker from a previous call; use together with Key Marker.
actions.amazon_s3_list_files.description: Lists files in the connected bucket, optionally under a folder, one page at a time.
actions.amazon_s3_list_files.props.conti: The nextContinuationToken from a previous call, to get the next page.
actions.amazon_s3_list_files.props.listF: Group keys by "/": return the immediate subfolders under the prefix in "folders" and only the files directly in it in "files".
actions.amazon_s3_list_files.props.maxRe: Maximum number of files and folders to return in this page (1–1000). Defaults to 100.
actions.amazon_s3_list_files.props.prefi: Only list keys that start with this prefix, e.g. "invoices/2024/". Leave empty for the whole bucket.
actions.amazon_s3_list_files.props.start: Only list keys that sort after this key. Ignored when a continuation token is given.
actions.amazon_s3_move_file.description: Moves or renames a file within the connected bucket.
actions.amazon_s3_move_file.props.destin: The new full key, including the file name, e.g. "archive/2024/q1.csv".
actions.amazon_s3_move_file.props.source: The full key of the file to move, as returned by List Files.
actions.amazon_s3_read_file.description: Reads a file, returning text content inline and the file itself for later steps.
actions.amazon_s3_read_file.props.key.de: The full key (path) of the file, e.g. "reports/2024/q1.csv", as returned by List Files.
actions.amazon_s3_read_file.props.versio: A version id from List File Versions. Leave empty for the current version.
actions.amazon_s3_set_file_tags.descript: Replaces all tags on a file with the given set.
actions.amazon_s3_set_file_tags.props.ke: The full key (path) of the file, as returned by List Files.
actions.amazon_s3_set_file_tags.props.ta: The complete tag set as key-value pairs, e.g. {"project": "alpha", "status": "final"}.
actions.amazon_s3_set_file_tags.props.ve: A version id from List File Versions. Leave empty for the current version.
actions.amazon_s3_upload_file.descriptio: Uploads a file or text content to an exact key in the connected bucket.
actions.amazon_s3_upload_file.props.cont: MIME type, e.g. "text/csv". Leave empty to guess from the key's extension.
actions.amazon_s3_upload_file.props.doNo: Fail instead of replacing a file that already exists at this key.
actions.amazon_s3_upload_file.props.file: The file to upload. Leave empty when using Text Content.
The full key (path) to write, including the file name and extension, e.g. "reports/2024/q1.csv".
actions.amazon_s3_upload_file.props.meta: Key-value pairs stored with the file as user metadata (x-amz-meta-*).
actions.amazon_s3_upload_file.props.text: Text to store as the file content, e.g. CSV or JSON. Leave empty when using File.
actions.decrypt-pgp-file.description: Decrypt a PGP encrypted file from S3 using a private key stored in AWS Secrets Manager
actions.decrypt-pgp-file.props.allowInse: Allow decryption using a key not marked for encryption (e.g. a signing-only key). Enable this if your PGP key was not flagged for encryption use.
actions.decrypt-pgp-file.props.allowUnau: Allow decryption of messages without integrity protection (no MDC). WARNING: Without MDC, a malicious actor can silently modify the ciphertext, so the decrypted output may have been tampered with. Only enable this when working with legacy files where integrity protection was never used.
actions.decrypt-pgp-file.props.key.descr: The key (path) of the encrypted file in S3
actions.decrypt-pgp-file.props.passphras: Optional ARN of the secret in AWS Secrets Manager containing the passphrase for the private key (if the key is encrypted)
actions.decrypt-pgp-file.props.secretArn: The ARN of the secret in AWS Secrets Manager containing the PGP private key
actions.decrypt-pgp-file.props.secretsMa: The AWS region where the Secrets Manager secret is stored (defaults to S3 region if not provided)
actions.deleteFile.props.key.description: The full path to the file within your S3 bucket (e.g. "documents/report.csv" or "myfile.txt"). This is also called the S3 "key".
actions.generate-signed-upload-url.descr: Generate a pre-signed URL that allows anyone with the link to upload a file directly to S3 without needing AWS credentials.
actions.generate-signed-upload-url.props: How long the upload URL should remain valid (in minutes).
The destination path and filename inside the bucket, e.g. "uploads/photo.jpg".
actions.generate-signed-url.description: Generate a signed URL for a file in a s3 bucket
actions.generate-signed-url.props.expire: How long the URL should remain valid (in minutes).
actions.generate-signed-url.props.key.de: The full path to the file within your S3 bucket (e.g. "documents/report.csv" or "myfile.txt"). This is also called the S3 "key".
actions.list-files.description: List all files from an S3 bucket folder/prefix.
actions.list-files.props.maxKeys.descrip: Maximum number of files to return (1–1000). Defaults to 1000. Use a lower number if you only need the most recent files.
actions.list-files.props.prefix.descript: Filter results to a specific folder. Enter the folder path including the trailing slash (e.g. "invoices/" or "reports/2024/"). Leave empty to list all files in the bucket.
actions.moveFile.description: Move a File to Another Folder
actions.moveFile.props.fileKey.descripti: The full path to the file you want to move (e.g. "old-folder/report.csv").
actions.moveFile.props.folderKey.descrip: The folder path to move the file into (e.g. "archive/" or "new-folder"). The file name is kept the same.
actions.read-file.description: Read a file from S3 to use it in other steps
actions.read-file.props.key.description: The full path to the file within your S3 bucket (e.g. "documents/report.csv" or "myfile.txt"). This is also called the S3 "key".
actions.upload-file.props.acl.descriptio: Who can access this file after upload. Use "Private" for internal files, "Public Read" to make the file publicly accessible via URL.
actions.upload-file.props.acl.options.op: Public Read/Write (anyone can view and upload)
actions.upload-file.props.file.descripti: The file to upload to S3.
actions.upload-file.props.fileName.descr: The name to save the file as in S3 (e.g. "report-2024.csv"). If left blank, a unique name is generated automatically.
actions.upload-file.props.type.descripti: Content Type of the uploaded file, if not set the API will try to figure out the content type.
triggers.new_file.description: Triggers when you add or update a file in your bucket. The bucket/folder you choose must not contain more than 10,000 files.
triggers.new_file.props.markdown.descrip: Triggers when you add or update a file in your bucket. The bucket/folder you choose must not contain more than 10,000 files.
